t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each gnome comes in pairs and the size they appear in is irrelevant only their colours matter. They take you to different forests which yield different amounts of mushrooms. It is important to remember which colour yields the most mushrooms so that you can pick it, However this number may vary as the game goes on so it is important to focus in order to collect the most amount of mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes always come in pairs with the same colours. The colours are as follows, Orange + Brown, Green + Pink, Purple + Blue, Red + Yellow. There are two forests, One has a yellow basket and one has a red basket. Each gnome will lead you to one of the two forests which will produce a different amount of mushrooms, The forest which has the highest amount of mushrooms will change as you play the game. You have to see which forest results in the greatest amount of mushrooms and choose the corresponding gnomes to get you to that forest. Here is a list of which forest each gnome will lead you to (Red basket forest = RB  Yellow basket forest = YB)Orange gnome - RB forestGreen gnome - RB forestRed gnome - RB forestBlue gnome - RB forestBrown gnome - YB forestPurple gnome -  YB forestYellow gnome - YB forestPink gnome - YB forestRemember the size of each gnome or appearance of their hats is irrelevant THE ONLY THING THAT MATTERS IS THEIR COLOUR.Best of luck
